purpose: Development-only calibration of a frozen raw multimodal composer under a non-saturated regular and higher-order retrieval endpoint. This protocol cannot establish a paper-facing superiority claim.

candidate_bank.construction: deterministic metadata-only sampling before support targets or query payload are read

methods.ebm_program_ranker: main-effect EBM over exactly the 96 compiled program columns
methods.gbm_program_ranker: support-only permutation importance over exactly the 96 compiled program columns
methods.random_program_ranker: seeded uniform ordering of the same 96 programs

hidden_evaluator.score_serialization: all four support score vectors are written before query payload access
hidden_evaluator.higher_order_endpoint: held-out gain beyond B_known and the strongest legal proper-subset decomposition
hidden_evaluator.strict_label: positive regular and higher-order gain; both patient-bootstrap lower confidence bounds > 0; at least 60% held-out patients positive for each; both empirical null p <= 0.05

interpretation: A later test-role cache repeats this protocol without changes. The frozen historical and blind-discovery cohorts are prohibited from model selection and calibration.
